name: metrifi
description: MetriFi for Claude: one sign-in to the MetriFi platform plus the MetriFi site-design and GEO experiment skills, for credit unions and banks.

plugins.name: metrifi
plugins.description: The MetriFi plugin: one sign-in connects Claude to the MetriFi platform (Site Builder, GEO AI-search visibility, and CRO analytics) and adds the MetriFi skills. client-report audits an institution's existing site; generate-claude-design-system, generate-claude-design-page and page-design-process design and build a new one; campaign-setup stands up a new institution's first baseline campaign, and the GEO experiment skills run a campaign from research through to a reviewed client deliverable. Self-contained: this is the only plugin you need.
